Upper Text: [On Play][When Digivolving] By returning 1 of your opponent's level 3 Digimon or 1 of your Digimon to the hand, return 1 of your opponent's Digimon whose level is less than or equal to the returned Digimon's level to the hand.
[Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When another Digimon returns to the hand, ＜Recovery +1 (Deck)＞.
